description: Android activity class that observes media content changes via ContentObserver, manages permission requests, and updates UI buttons accordingly.

classes.name: MediaContentObserver
classes.description: An Android Activity that observes media content changes, handles permission requests, and updates UI buttons.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up content observer, UI components, and button click handlers.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of permission request for reading external storage.

methods.name: updateButtons
methods.description: Enables or disables UI buttons based on the scheduled state of media and photos jobs.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Unregisters the content observer when activity is destroyed.
